name: mentor-desk
description: Run the mentoring and judging of an overnight hackathon from your mentors' phones. Built for LAYOVER 2026.

paragraphs: Mentors walk the floor checking in on every team through the night, raise and pick up help requests, and in the morning the same app becomes their judging sheet. Organizers watch it all live from a laptop: who has been checked, who needs help, which mentor needs a nudge, and how the finalists scored.

Built for, and run live at, LAYOVER 2026: an overnight student hackathon at TinkerSpace Calicut with 98 teams, 160 builders and 11 mentor-judges, who logged 303 check-ins and 143 score sheets in one night.
▶ Try the live demo: the mentor app on your phone, the organizer dashboard at /admin (password demo). It's a seeded event that resets every hour, so click anything.
